findings.title: Fallback-locale loading only wired into the controller request cycle
findings.body: `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` is only invoked from `ApplicationController#set_locale`. Any code path that sets `I18n.locale` outside of a web request (Sidekiq jobs, mailers rendering in a user's locale, rake tasks, console usage) never calls this method. Because `lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb` requires translation files to be explicitly loaded with `I18n.ensure_loaded!`/`load_locale` before lookups work, the fallback locales (site default locale, `:en`) will not be loaded in those contexts, so fallback translations will silently fail to resolve (returning nil/raising `I18n::MissingTranslationData`) even though the feature appears to work for normal page requests.

findings.title: Fallback chain now depends on a DB/cache-backed SiteSetting instead of a static config value
findings.body: The previous `config.i18n.fallbacks = true` approach relied only on `I18n.default_locale`, a static value available at boot. The new `FallbackLocaleList#[]` calls `SiteSetting.default_locale` on every fallback resolution, which requires the `site_settings` table/cache to be available. If any translation lookup occurs before migrations have run (fresh install, `rake db:migrate`, `assets:precompile` on a new deployment, etc.), this will raise a DB error where translation previously worked fine with the static fallback.

findings.title: LRU translation cache is not invalidated when SiteSetting.default_locale changes
findings.body: The cache key `"#{key}#{config.locale}#{config.backend.object_id}"` only accounts for the requested locale, not the locale a fallback translation actually came from. Since the fallback chain now depends on the mutable `SiteSetting.default_locale` (added in config/initializers/i18n.rb), changing that setting at runtime does not bust already-cached fallback results. Users/admins can keep seeing translations resolved under the old default locale until the 300-entry LRU naturally evicts those keys or the process restarts, producing stale/incorrect localized content.

findings.title: No tests added for the new fallback behavior
findings.body: This PR introduces a new `FallbackLocaleList` class, a new `I18n.ensure_loaded!`/`I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` loading path, and changes `ApplicationController#set_locale`, but no spec files were added or updated to verify fallback ordering, lazy-loading of fallback locale files, or interaction with the LRU translation cache. This is user-facing localization behavior and should have test coverage before merging.

findings.title: Fallback behavior is now enabled unconditionally in every environment
findings.body: Previously `config.i18n.fallbacks = true` was only set in production, profile, and cloud66 production configs; development/test presumably ran without fallbacks. This new initializer enables `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks` and the custom `FallbackLocaleList` for all environments, including test and development. This silently changes behavior so that missing translations in those environments now resolve to the default locale or English instead of raising, which can mask genuine missing-translation bugs during development and in the test suite.
